workflowConfig.name: Google Drive Video Summarizer
workflowConfig.description: Automatically summarize video folders from Google Drive and send PDF reports via Telegram
workflowConfig.author: n8n Video Summarizer

google.notes: Create service account in Google Cloud Console and download JSON key

openai.notes: Get API key from OpenAI platform

telegram.notes: Create bot with @BotFather and get token

googleDrive.description: Google Drive folder ID containing videos to summarize

telegram.description: Telegram chat ID where reports will be sent
telegram.howToGet: Send message to your bot, then check https://api.telegram.org/bot<YOUR_BOT_TOKEN>/getUpdates

videoFormats.notes: FFmpeg must be installed on n8n server to process these formats

videoSummary.system: You are a video summarization assistant. Analyze the provided video metadata and create a concise summary.

customization.notes: Adjust temperature for more/less creative summaries

pdfTemplate.title: Video Folder Summary Report
pdfTemplate.customization: Modify HTML template in 'Generate PDF Report' node

optimization.notes: Set downloadVideos=true only if content analysis is needed

googleDriveAccess.solution: Ensure service account has access to the folder

telegramDelivery.solution: Verify chat ID and bot permissions
